# Leapsome | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Standardizing performance processes | Main link validation of performance processes is standardized with “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| OKR aligned to strategy | The main link for validation of OKR and strategy alignment is “People or candidate data entry-rule or approval processing-Staff Manager self-help-results entry report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. ### Scene 3: Employees investigating action The main link to verify the action was “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Capacity and learning development | The main link validation capacity and learning development is based on “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results entry into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
